management.claim: The CEO says results are structurally stronger than at the same point in the last cycle.
management.quote: Our results are structurally stronger compared with the same point in the last cycle, and we delivered them while sustaining investments and continuing to return capital to shareholders.

management.claim: The CEO says the company executed with discipline even at cyclical lows.
management.quote: Even at cyclical lows, we executed with discipline.

management.claim: The CEO sees early signs of improvement in large agriculture, led by North America.
management.quote: As we enter fiscal 2027, we’re seeing early signs of improvement in large agriculture, led by North America,

management.claim: The CEO says the outlook has a wider range of outcomes because of continued uncertainty in key end markets.
management.quote: Given continued uncertainty in key end markets, our outlook reflects a wider range of outcomes.

tone.label: balanced
tone.reason: The CEO stresses disciplined execution and early signs of improvement, but also cyclical lows and continued uncertainty in key end markets.
